items.prompt:
Which sentence is an opinion?
A) Dogs have four legs.
B) I think dogs are better pets than cats.
C) Cats sleep during the day.
D) Some dogs are big.

steps: An opinion tells what someone thinks or believes. 'I think' signals an opinion. Options A, C, and D are facts.

items.prompt:
What is the job of a closing sentence in an opinion piece?
A) To introduce the topic
B) To give a reason for the opinion
C) To wrap up the piece and restate the opinion
D) To add a new idea

steps: A closing sentence ends the opinion piece. It wraps things up and often restates the opinion in a new way.

items.prompt:
Which linking word BEST completes this sentence? 'I think summer is the best season ___ there is no school and I can swim every day.'
A) but
B) because
C) although
D) unless

steps: 'Because' connects the opinion (summer is the best) to the reason (no school, can swim). It is the most common linking word for opinion reasons.

items.prompt:
Read the opinion piece below. Which sentence is OFF-TOPIC and should be removed?

'I think every student should learn to paint. Painting is wonderful because it builds creativity and teaches patience. My art teacher has red hair. Also, painting is great because it gives students a way to express their feelings without words.'
A) 'I think every student should learn to paint.'
B) 'Painting is wonderful because it builds creativity and teaches patience.'
C) 'My art teacher has red hair.'
D) 'Also, painting is great because it gives students a way to express their feelings without words.'

steps: The topic is why students should learn to paint. The sentence about the teacher's hair has nothing to do with the opinion or the reasons.

items.prompt:
A student wrote: 'I think students should have free reading time. Books are things you read. Also, reading is good.' What is the MAIN problem with this opinion piece?
A) It has too many reasons.
B) The reasons do not explain WHY reading time is good.
C) It has no topic sentence.
D) The closing sentence is too long.

steps: The reasons ('Books are things you read' and 'reading is good') are vague. They do not use 'because' to explain WHY reading time is a good idea. Strong reasons are specific and use linking words.

items.prompt:
Which ordering of sentences makes the BEST opinion piece?
A) Reason, topic sentence, closing sentence
B) Closing sentence, reason, topic sentence
C) Topic sentence, reasons, closing sentence
D) Reasons, closing sentence, topic sentence

steps: An opinion piece follows this order: (1) topic sentence that states the opinion, (2) reasons that support the opinion, (3) closing sentence that wraps up.

items.prompt:
Read both topic sentences below. Which is STRONGER, and why?

Sentence 1: 'Pizza is a food.'
Sentence 2: 'I believe that pizza is the perfect school lunch because it is delicious, filling, and loved by almost every student.'
Explain what makes the stronger sentence effective.
items.answer: Sentence 2 is stronger. It states a clear opinion ('I believe'), names the topic specifically ('pizza' as 'perfect school lunch'), and gives preview reasons ('delicious, filling, loved by almost every student'). Sentence 1 is just a fact with no opinion.

steps: A strong topic sentence: uses 'I think/I believe,' names the topic, states the opinion clearly, and may hint at reasons.
Sentence 2 does all of these; Sentence 1 does none.

items.prompt: Write a complete 4-sentence opinion piece about whether technology helps or hurts learning. Your piece must use 'because,' 'also,' and end with a sentence that does NOT begin with 'That is why.'
items.answer: Sample: I believe that technology helps students learn when it is used the right way. Technology is helpful because it allows students to research any topic, watch educational videos, and practice skills with fun apps. Also, technology is useful because it lets students work at their own pace and get instant feedback on what they need to improve. Students who use technology wisely are better prepared for the world they will grow up in.

steps: Closing sentence without 'That is why' (use a general statement instead).
